name: Thoracic Open Book
steps: Lie on one side with hips and knees bent at right angles and your knees stacked.
Extend both arms in front of your chest and bring your palms together.
Keep your knees pinned together on the floor as you sweep your top arm up and across toward the floor behind you.
Follow your moving hand with your eyes and allow your upper back and chest to rotate open comfortably without letting your knees lift.
Sweep your top arm slowly back to the starting stack, continuing smoothly for the target duration on one side before switching sides.
tips: Keep your knees pressed together on the floor so the rotation happens cleanly in your upper back rather than your lower back.
Exhale softly as your chest opens wide to ease into a greater range of motion.
